 Privacy Notice Autumn leaves are gathering, there's a nip in the air, and Halloween is just around the corner. However, rather than fearing the colder months to come, one guaranteed method to combat the winter blues is to get lost in a good show.
 Grab yourself a warm blanket and settle down to some outstanding telly. we'd recommend . For many Netflix viewers, The Haunting of Hill House is must-see TV.
 Regular viewers and critics have heaped so much praise on Hill House over the years that people who typically avoid horror have also become fans. Netflix's synopsis for the show reads: "Flashing between past and present, a fractured family confronts haunting memories of their old home and the terrifying events that drove them from it."
 What is the Haunting of Hill House about?
 Victoria Pedretti stars in Netflix's The Haunting series, made up of The Haunting of Bly Manor and The Haunting of Hill House. 
 (Image: NETFLIX) 
 The Haunting of Hill House is about five siblings who are quite literally haunted by their childhood. The show unfolds across two timelines: the present day and flashbacks building towards a pivotal day in 1992.
 During that summer, the Crain family relocate to Hill House, with plans to finance their dream home through renovating and selling the grand property. 
 They end up staying longer than planned, but horrifying events ultimately drive them from the house. Later on in the present, a tragedy reunites the family, compelling them to face the ghosts of their past.
 The ensemble cast includes Michiel Huisman, Elizabeth Reaser, Oliver Jackson-Cohen, Kate Siegel, and Victoria Pedretti portraying the adult Crain siblings.
 The 10-episode show is loosely adapted from Shirley Jackson's 1969 novel of the same name.

 What viewers think
 (Image: Netflix) 
 The programme boasts a 93% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes. The critical consensus says: "The Haunting of Hill House is an effective ghost story whose steadily mounting anticipation is just as satisfying as its chilling payoff."
 Although the show came out in 2018, one viewer recently recommended it again on Reddit: "Such a beautiful show. Its haunting music, great actors. It's easily the best show Mike Flanagan has ever done. A true masterpiece. Way better than his current show Carrie, which has a YA feel to it. I hope he goes back to this kind of stuff..
 "Highly recommended. Give it a try if you haven't seen it yet."
 One person replied: "Anytime I rewatch the series I make sure to watch episodes 4-5-6 in a row. Perfection." A third said: "Absolute perfection 10/10"
 Another viewer wrote on IMDB: "This isn't just great horror - it's brilliant filmmaking. Everything from the writing to the cast to the cinematography to the editing is just amazing. 
 "I was immediately hooked in from the first episode and wasn't able to stop (thank goodness I started in the morning and have a cold... and therefor a good excuse to lounge in front of the TV all day!)."
 Where can you stream The Haunting of Hill House?
 The complete 10-episode series of The Haunting of Hill House is available to stream on Netflix at any time. Episodes vary in length from 42–71 minutes.
